welcome.heroTitle: One identity for every Avarewase app
welcome.heroDescription: Avarewase Auth is the central sign-on provider for your organization — a single secure account that connects to every app you use, protected by two-factor authentication and managed from one admin console.

sso.title: Single Sign-On
sso.description: One set of credentials for every connected application, built on OAuth2 and OpenID Connect.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Protect every account with TOTP-based two-factor authentication and one-time recovery codes.

directory.title: Centralized Directory
directory.description: Manage every member, their stage, and their role from a single admin console.

accessControl.title: Client Access Control
accessControl.description: Grant connected apps access to everyone, a specific stage, or hand-picked individuals.

recovery.title: Self-Service Recovery
recovery.description: One-time, time-limited links for password resets and profile photo updates — no support ticket required.

integrations.title: Built for Integrations
integrations.description: A standards-based identity provider that any OAuth2/OIDC client app can plug into in minutes.
